name: @stackwright/build-scripts
description: Build-time scripts for Stackwright projects (prebuild image processing, YAML compilation)

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const fields=[...Object.values(p.dependencies||{}),...Object.values(p.peerDependencies||{})];const bad=fields.filter(v=>String(v).includes('workspace:'));if(bad.length){console.error('ERR: workspace: specifiers found in publishable dep fields:',bad);process.exit(1)}"
